observed.caption: Silhouetted pedestrians walk along a busy urban road at twilight with a tall building and traffic on the left and large trees on the right.
observed.description: A paved multi-lane road with white lane markings stretches into the distance under a pale blue to warm twilight sky. On the left a tall brown high-rise building with many windows and antennas stands beside a lower building with a large billboard, with several dark cars and vans along the curb and moving in the lanes and green and yellow buses further down the road. Two silhouetted figures are on the roadway, one in the foreground walking away from the camera near the curb and another mid-distance crossing the lanes. On the right large trees with spreading branches overhang the scene, a metal railing runs along the sidewalk, and double-headed streetlight poles line both sides of the road. Distant high-rise buildings, smaller trees, and a low sun near the horizon are visible in the background, casting the foreground into shadow.
